title: Power Systems Agent Benchmark: Executable Evaluation of AI Agents in Electric Power Engineering
description: Executable benchmark and paper artifact package for evaluating tool-using AI agents in electric power engineering. The release contains benchmark code, 41 public executable task families, deterministic evaluators and baselines, public reference-run submissions/results/logs, public model-harness grid artifacts, held-out generator validation, and aggregate-only held-out summaries.
notes: Public split artifacts include per-case submissions, evaluator results, and sanitized agent logs. Held-out per-case artifacts are intentionally excluded; only aggregate held-out summaries are published to avoid disclosing held-out answers.
